issue.title: Add compact percentage formatter utility for logs
issue.body:
Add a small, self-contained utility in `Factory.Core` that formats a ratio (`double`, 0.0-1.0) as a compact percentage string for structured logging (e.g. `0.5` -> `50%`, `0.333` -> `33.3%`) — something progress/success-rate logging could use instead of manual multiplication and formatting. Keep it to one small static class/method plus unit tests in the matching test project; no other files should need to change. Follow AGENTS.md conventions (small cohesive class, explicit naming, no speculative abstraction).

This task is queued to exercise the live second-agent review pipeline end-to-end (SF-712); a second agent will automatically review this change after implementation, no action needed from the implementing agent regarding review.
